page.overview:
Who is Thom Merrilin?

Thomdril "Thom" Merrilin (TOM MER-rih-lihn) is a gleeman and, formerly, a court bard in Andor.

He is six feet tall, and lanky, with a gnarled, leathery face, sharp blue eyes, white hair long enough to touch his collar, bushy white eyebrows, and long white mustaches that hang down on either side of his mouth., Thom Merrillin|comp}} He typically wears the cloak of a gleeman "more patches than cloak, and more colors than you can think of." When he arrives in Emond's Field he also has a long coat with odd baggy sleeves and big pockets. He smokes a long-stemmed, ornately carved pipe.

While Thom's date of birth is not given in the books or The Wheel of Time Companion, Robert Jordan's private notes on Andor state he is about 19–20 years older than Morgase, placing his year of birth as 937- and in his early 60s during the main events of the book. While this is not a fully canonical source, it fits in well with comments made by other characters, namely him being roughly "twice [Morgase's] age" and still "in his prime" in period leading up to ., Owyn|owyn}}

Thom had at least one sibling, a brother. Whatever other family he had were already dead by . His last remaining relative, his brother's only son, was from eastern Andor, near Aringill, so it is possible this is where Thom was born too.

Also known as: Thom, Master Bard.
